TOOL_PREFERENCES (permanent):
- str_replace: lineHint is mandatory on files >100 lines. Standard workflow: grep-file → read-lines → str_replace with lineHint.
- grep-file: do NOT use | alternations in regex — causes 'Unterminated group'. Use separate grep-file calls.
- session-notes: actions are read/write/clear only. To rewrite notes: clear then write individually.
- save-all instead of save-file (save-file needs tool_search each session). save-all silently skips unchanged files — normal.
- open-file before str_replace when editor focus may have shifted (wrong active editor is the cause of 'closest area found' errors).
- checkpatch filePath: always use full absolute path from list-open-files — relative paths resolve to Pulsar install dir, not project root.
- run-command: PowerShell uses ; not && as command separator.
- get-repo-map is MANDATORY second step after reading session notes at every session start. Call it before any grep/read/list to orient on project structure.

TOOL_QUIRKS (permanent):
- replace-block: 0 hits lifetime — only use on genuinely brace-delimited blocks, never bare if/for.
- delete-block: startContent/endContent anchors work well for multi-line dead-code removal; cleaner than str_replace for blocks.
- sed: bypasses ambiguity guard — use when str_replace is blocked by a TDZ crash in the running server. CAUTION: unreliable on module.exports lines when nearby template literals contain partial matches — always dryRun:true first.
- occurrence:N: first instinct for ambiguous patterns before reaching for apply-patch.
- apply-patch: use for edits touching multiple scattered locations. dryRun:true first on non-trivial patches. For >30% of file, use replace-document instead. Two nearly-identical adjacent hunks confuse fuzzy rescue — use separate str_replace+lineHint+afterHint instead. LIFETIME 0 hits — avoid; str_replace+lineHint is more reliable.
- replace-document: not wired to inline style check (too noisy). checkpatch manually after large rewrites. USE for any edit touching a markdown table (pipes break str_replace matching).
- replace-function-body: ambiguous when function name appears 6+ times (calls + definition). Use afterHint or occurrence:N to target the definition. Unreliable near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const in mcp-registration.js — use str_replace+lineHint in that zone instead.
- replace-across-files: glob must always be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/ backup). No $1/$2 backreferences in replacement strings in regex mode — written as literals. Use separate literal calls per distinct pattern instead.
- str_replace on backtick-heavy or quote-heavy markdown lines fails due to escaping — use insert with afterContent anchor instead.
- After save of mcp-registration.js: hot-reload shifts active editor. Always open-file the next target after any mcp-registration save.
- When adding a new top-level key to editStats: add defensive ||{} guards to ALL direct-access sites in getEditStats session block. Also close the previous key's object properly first (missing }, is silent).
- emoji in old_str breaks str_replace matching — always use lineHint when old_str starts with an emoji heading.

MCREG_ARCHITECTURE (reference):
- styleStats / lifetimeStyleStats: per-rule { introduced: 0 } objects + _totalCHEdits, _totalViolations, _cleanEdits, _checkpatchRuns, _checkpatchViolations counters.
- Reset loop is self-maintaining: Object.keys(styleStats) — adding new rules to the stat objects is sufficient, no reset block changes needed.
- bumpStyle(type, n): gates on styleStats[type] existing — new rules must be in both stat object literals.
- applyStyleCheck(newStr, filePath): inline check, isWholeFile=false — only fires on .c/.h, only checks added/changed lines. Guards null internally — no || "" needed at call sites.
- checkpatch tool: isWholeFile=true — audits full file, separate _checkpatchRuns counter.
- buildStyleReport(): module-scope function (promoted from closure in v0.9.3).
- summarise() / buildReport(): module-scope functions. buildReport() uses st(key) = stats[key]||{} accessor for optional tools.
- sumFails(obj): module-scope helper — Object.values(obj||{}).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0).
- maybeLintSuffix(lint, editor, startRow, endRow): async helper before lintSnapshot. Replaces 13 IIFEs.
- isCodeFilePath(p): module-scope helper using CODE_FILE_RE. Replaces 20 inline regex tests.
- isGhidraFile(filePath, text): module-scope — detects .bin.c/.xbe.c patterns + FUN_/DAT_/PTR_ density >5%.
- fnRe: declared locally in each of 3 handlers (list-project-functions, list-functions, get-function-list-with-comments) — grep all instances before fixing.
- BASELINE RULE: .mcp-baseline/ is a read-only backup — NEVER edit it. replace-across-files glob must be lib/*.js scope only.
- Stats split (v0.10.2): faults (tool misused/broken) vs misses (ran fine, content not there) — separate in summarise() output.
- Stats groups in summarise(): Edit (editFaults/editMisses), Search (hits/misses), RE/Ghidra (faults/misses, conditional), Commands (faults/misses, conditional).
- anchorError(hintName, hintValue, result): module-scope helper — formats null (not found) and ambiguous resolveAnchor results into user-facing error strings.

TREE_SITTER_ARCHITECTURE (reference):
- lib/tree-sitter-symbols.js: getSymbolsFromEditor(editor), getSymbolsFromText(text, filePath), getSymbols(editor, text, filePath), findFunction(symbols, name, hints), resolveAnchor(hint, symbols, text), braceEndRow(lines, fromRow). All exported.
- resolveAnchor resolution chain: (1) exact symbol name → sym.endRow [symbolEnd], (2) pure integer → lineNumber, (3) text.indexOf scan with uniqueness check [string]. Returns {row, via, ambiguous?, matches?}. Ambiguity fires at both symbol and string level.
- 19 resolveAnchor call sites in mcp-registration.js — all afterHint/betweenHint go through tree-sitter.
- afterHint:"fn_name" now resolves to END of that function (sym.endRow), not first char occurrence — insert-after semantics are correct.
- betweenHint:{start:"fn_a", end:"fn_b"} spans from end of fn_a to end of fn_b semantically.
- GHIDRA_FUNC_RE: intentionally NOT migrated — FUN_/DAT_/PTR_ placeholder names in decompiled C have no tree-sitter grammar. Regex fallback only.
- naming-checker.js uses getSymbolsFromText() — FN_DEF_RE fully removed in v0.10.21.

LESSONS PERMANENT:
1. replace-across-files regex mode: $1/$2 in replacement = literal string, NOT backreference. Use separate literal calls per distinct pattern.
2. apply-patch fuzzy rescue fails silently-wrong on adjacent near-identical lines — use str_replace+lineHint+afterHint per site instead.
3. replace-across-files glob must be lib/*.js — NEVER **/*.js (hits .mcp-baseline/ read-only backup).
4. When two nearly-identical hunks exist in a patch, fuzzy can merge them — use two separate str_replace with afterHint instead.
5. str_replace afterHint can match a later occurrence of a common string — when wrong site fires, drop afterHint and use lineHint only, or add fuzzyWhitespace:true.
6. When a function needs multiple internal edits, go straight to replace-function-body with lineHint — never chain str_replace calls inside a single function. Merges are fragile when surrounding lines are similar.
7. sed is unreliable on module.exports lines when nearby template literals contain partial matches. Always dryRun:true with sed first.
8. str_replace on the require line adjacent to a comment block can garble the end of the comment line. Check adjacent comment lines after any require-line edit.
9. node --check catches embedded */ inside block comments ("Invalid or unexpected token"). Never write /* ... */ ... */ on a single line — convert to // comment instead.
10. replace-function-body on mcp-registration.js near TOOL_CATALOGUE export const is unreliable (tree-sitter mis-reports endRow). Use str_replace+lineHint in that zone.
11. glob test/**/*.c returns 0 results — use **/*.c (bare) for project-wide C scans.
12. insert_line inserts BEFORE that line number. To insert after L1994, use insert_line:1995.
13. save-all before running Get-Content grep in PowerShell — PowerShell reads disk not buffer.
14. str_replace fails on markdown table rows (pipes). Use replace-document for any edit touching a table.
